mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous two months indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST drops by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month indicates strengthening supply-side activity, which is a positive signal for economic growth and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the previous three months signals an easing monetary policy, which is generally positive for equity markets, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS shows a sustained decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by less than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates weakening consumer demand, which is a negative signal for the S&P 500, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS growth is less than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously over the previous month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals an economic contraction, which is a negative indicator for the S&P 500, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 shows negative growth for two consecutive quarters.
